summary: Pin the managed RDC process to the private Termux temporary directory so ADB can restart independently of the remote caller environment.
reason: RDC remained healthy while a raw ADB command could not restart a missing ADB server because the remote shell fell back to an unwritable global temporary path.

tests.name: remote-desktop-watchdog
tests.evidence: test-remote-desktop-watchdog.py passed 16 tests including private temporary-directory environment inheritance.

capabilities.reason: Restores reliable execution for the existing remote_desktop and device.adb capabilities without changing scope, entrypoints or health semantics.

architecture.reason: Uses the existing RDC controller and Tier-0 release owner; no new daemon, scheduler, database, router or source of truth.

rollback: Revert the source commit and promote the prior immutable Tier-0 last-known-good release.
limitations: The change governs processes spawned through managed RDC; unrelated unmanaged shells retain their own environment.
No Android payment activity or banking journey is modified.
No live payment is executed by this maintenance change.
